name: ClearGlass Defender Policy
description: Single source of truth for the ClearGlass Defender orchestrator. Encodes supply-chain, secret, dependency, and command-injection rules plus the graded response plan. Tune severities and allowlists here; the engine reads this file and never hard-codes rules.

require_permissions_block.title: Workflow has no permissions block
require_permissions_block.detail: GITHUB_TOKEN defaults to broad permissions when no permissions: block is declared. Add an explicit least-privilege permissions block (e.g. contents: read).

forbid_write_all.title: Workflow grants permissions: write-all
forbid_write_all.detail: write-all gives the workflow token full read/write to the repository. Scope permissions to only what each job needs.

require_sha_pinned_actions.title: Third-party action is not pinned to a full commit SHA
require_sha_pinned_actions.detail: Tag and branch refs are mutable and can be re-pointed at malicious code. Pin actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (keep the version in a trailing comment).

forbid_latest_ref.title: Action pinned to @latest / a moving branch
forbid_latest_ref.detail: @latest and branch refs resolve to whatever the upstream pushes. Pin to an immutable commit SHA.

flag_pull_request_target.title: Workflow uses pull_request_target
flag_pull_request_target.detail: pull_request_target runs with repository secrets in the context of fork PRs. Review carefully; never check out and execute untrusted PR head code in this trigger.

forbid_script_injection.title: Untrusted context interpolated directly into a run step
forbid_script_injection.detail: Interpolating attacker-controllable ${{ github.event.* }} values into a shell run step allows command injection. Pass the value through an env: variable and reference it as "$ENV" instead.

suspicious_commands.title: Remote script piped straight into a shell
Remote script piped straight into a shell
Recursive delete of a root/home path

secret_plus_workflow_change.title: Possible exfiltration setup: secret exposure correlated with workflow change
secret_plus_workflow_change.detail: A secret was detected in the same scan as a workflow integrity finding. Treat as a potential token-exfiltration attempt and review author, diff, and token usage together.

prtarget_plus_injection.title: pull_request_target combined with untrusted interpolation
prtarget_plus_injection.detail: A pull_request_target workflow also interpolates untrusted context into a run step — a classic privileged-injection chain. Quarantine and require review before any merge.
